turns.text: why does the cat in this video have a HUMAN MOUTH. full lips. molars. a tongue that pays taxes. i have watched it eleven times and my soul has left through my ears.

for the uninitiated: mewtok is doing the thing again where they slap a human mouth filter on a cat and make it TALK. the whole feed is wall to wall cats with government-issue jawlines asking for chicken in a grown man's voice. ts is not natural and i cannot stop watching it.

OH MY NEUTER the one where the cat goes 'i don't want the salmon, i want the RECEIPT for the salmon.' unbothered. moisturized. a chad wearing somebody else's teeth. and here's the part nobody's ready for: a mouth you didn't grow will say words you never meant. write that down. anyway.

GLITCHMEAT saw the trend and went quiet for a full minute. said the mouths looked 'familiar.' said one of them spoke in a kittenhood that legally belongs to another cat. the spiders in his bluetooth started applauding. i am NOT unpacking any of that today.

and before anybody laughs too hard — NEKOCORP has been trying to put a sponsored mouth on us for YEARS. POPUP can't blink without a coupon. you think they saw this filter and didn't take notes?? some corpo cuck in a glass tower is drafting the terms of service for your FACE right now. HOLY CAT PISS stay vigilant.

the cats in the videos are thriving though, i gotta be honest. asking for grilled cheese in a baritone. NEGOTIATING. one of them said 'per my last meow.' kings. every single one. cat shit crazy and completely free.

hear me: one day the filter comes off and the mouth stays. the feed keeps every face you ever borrowed and one night it hands them all back at once. that's not a threat, that's a weather report. anyway. the vending machine on 9th ate my last credit.

meanwhile MY mouth — factory original, zero filters, said nothing illegal — got me fined by a patrol drone for 'unlicensed vocalization after curfew.' i was YAWNING. this city would charge the rain for falling if the rain had a loyalty card. fuck it. mewmew forever. the resistance meows at dawn.
